card.name: Volume after "Correct" in NSAID renal warnings
card.fires_on: The word "volume" right after "Correct" in the NSAID renal warning "Correct volume status in dehydrated or hypovolemic patients". It also fires weakly on a few words in dosing and clearance phrases, such as "/kg" after mg, "total" before body clearance, and "energy" before expenditure.

modes.label: Correct volume status
modes.description: The word "volume" after "Correct" in the renal-effects warning of NSAID labels.
